**Performance: pass-with-notes** at `001a3b8406f694c2b77ff69dddda5ae47e69a480`. **P176-F001 and P176-F002 closed.**

Delta from [the first-round block](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/pull/176#issuecomment-6716901267), governance `6095292`.

**Coverage repair:** tracked `.cargo/config.toml` sets `[build] jobs = 4` and `[env] RUST_TEST_THREADS = { value = "4", force = false }`. [Cargo discovers configuration from cwd and its ancestors](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/config.html#hierarchical-structure), not only the caller's HOME. The previously traced fixture build, native daemon bounce and standalone gate all launch Cargo with cwd inside this repository, so they receive the defaults without inheriting Just exports. The fixture's curated environment remains intact.

The supplied coder probe table uses an identical config in a scratch crate under `env -i`: default4/4, a subdirectory4/4, job override2, caller test-thread override1, and config-removed control16/no-thread-env. That is reported execution evidence, not a local rerun by this reviewer. It matches the configuration contract and the actual launcher cwd boundaries.

**Launch repair:** Justfile is byte-identical to base main `28d7c7bd` by Git diff; its new standalone banners and exports are removed. The only cap printf remains inside the already-running shared-build script. No added shell/helper launch, timer, poll or daemon change. Cargo now reads/parses the small tracked config during its existing configuration lookup; that is filesystem work, not a process.

Shared-build still exports the explicit PIJ_CARGO_JOBS mapping to build/test settings, validates positive values before locking/Cargo, and retains nice/taskpolicy, target locking and CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0. The prior 16-core/two-build assessment stands: four is a reasonable provisional default, not a CPU reservation or measured optimum.

**Limits:** environment/CLI or more-specific Cargo config can override the defaults. Overrides win only when they reach the Cargo child; the isolated fixture does not copy arbitrary caller environment. Libtest threads are not a global native-thread/process cap. CI now receives repository config too; this is no longer the round-1 “CI unaffected” claim. Nextest's independent process concurrency and the externally governed two-build limit are not newly capped by this file.

**CI:** [42444630104](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42444630104) succeeds at this exact SHA. Node **22 and 24 each execute 20 shared-build cases**; Node22 proof uses its direct job log rather than an incomplete aggregate cached log. Wrapper defaults/overrides/invalid values pass, with typecheck/Biome and Rust checks successful. Both Delivers runs succeed. These tests exercise the wrapper; the config's clean-environment probe is the separately supplied coder evidence.

Worktree and GitHub heads agree; clean and CLEAN/MERGEABLE. No local Cargo, build, test or fake-Cargo run. No remaining performance blocker.
